applies_to: cohorts with fewer than 8 patients (a fold holds out a single patient)
reason: the fold-level patient-bootstrap CI degenerates to the point estimate when one patient is held out (cSCC v03: 800/800 rows; CRC v03: about 80 percent)
registered_finding_rule: per-patient pooled interval from the all-fold record: mean of per-patient held-out gains, patient bootstrap over the cohort, sign count >= n_patients - 1; used in place of the per-fold CI clause
source: coordinator 2026-10-23 16:00 UTC; v04 keeps its registered rule (not retrofitted)
